source: Captured in the league owner's own logged-in Chrome, with their consent, from the Transaction History page of one NFL dynasty league. League and team ids are replaced with placeholders; the sample rows are synthetic and only show the shape.

download.control: "Download all as CSV" button on the page

claimDropCsv.note: Two columns are both named "Team": the first is the player's NFL club, the second is the fantasy team. There is no player id column.

tradeCsv.note: Already read by lib/league-import/fantrax/fantraxTradeHistoryCsv.ts. The Trade tab's download request was NOT captured here; only view=TRADE on the page's data request was seen.

notCaptured: The download with view=TRADE or view=LINEUP
